# Whisper Large-v3-Turbo Turkish Domain Adaptation

> Canonical public research, manuscript, metrics, and reproducibility hub for Turkish telephone-like speech adaptation of `openai/whisper-large-v3-turbo`.

Repository: https://github.com/Darkem0/whisper-turkish-domain-adaptation
Author: Emre Aslan
Language: Turkish and English
License: MIT for original code and documentation; datasets and models retain their own licenses.

## Canonical conclusions

- Best controlled MediaSpeech Phone normalized WER: A7 step-200 = 0.15428452289943706.
- Best A7 robustness-proxy normalized WER: A7 step-150 = 0.14757801098061019.
- Staged domain adaptation is supported for the open-data telephone proxy.
- A7 has a documented general-domain cost, especially on CV Scripted.
- Augmentation contribution is inconclusive because A7 jointly changed parent continuation, source balance, and augmentation.
- A4 decoder-only remains a strong robustness Pareto candidate.
- These are open-data proxy results, not verified operational call-center performance.

## Evidence classes

- Artefact verified: checkpoint, prediction, hash, progress, or frozen-evaluation evidence exists.
- Archival report: historical report exists but some original artefacts are unavailable.
- Conversation memory: retained ChatGPT/project memory without a complete public artefact chain.
- Researched not executed: literature or architecture research only.

Do not present researched-only methods as executed experiments.

## Main experimental series

- Legacy-H0–H4: historical baseline, narrow-domain LoRA, general Turkish LoRA, balanced-phone continuation, repeat-safe decoding.
- Controlled A0–A7: base, encoder/decoder LoRA scope, replay, clean schedules, staged source-anchored telephone adaptation.

## Important negative results

- MediaSpeech-only LoRA degraded normalized WER.
- Lower validation loss did not guarantee better real-call behavior.
- Ten-percent replay did not prevent CV Scripted forgetting.
- Wider encoder+decoder LoRA scope did not automatically produce synergy.
- MEM3/MEM4 batching changed predictions and was rejected for controlled evaluation.
- The first A5–A6 zero-delta result was invalid because A6 was compared with itself; it is superseded.

## Privacy boundary

This public repository excludes private audio, private transcripts, customer or employee identifiers, internal service topology, credentials, model checkpoints, local absolute paths, and restricted datasets.
